description: Design and build macOS app icons and in-app icon tiles procedurally, with no image generator. Draw flat layers with a Swift/AppKit script, assemble them into an Icon Composer .icon (Liquid Glass, light and dark), compile it with actool outside Xcode, and verify how macOS renders it next to system icons. Also covers matching SwiftUI tiles for icons shown inside the app. Use when creating, redrawing or reviewing a Mac app's icon or its in-app icon style.
